podcast.body: The Eagles' 1994 Hell Freezes Over tour marked a significant moment in concert pricing, as they became the first act to charge more than $100 for a concert ticket. Despite initial complaints from fans, audiences ultimately "ponied up" and purchased the tickets, setting a new precedent for concert pricing in the industry. "In 1994, they became the first act to charge more than $100 for a ticket for their hell freezes over tour."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Weird History of Concert Tickets Part 2
